notes: Ebro Foods S.A. (BME: EBRO) — world's largest rice company and second-largest pasta producer. Brands include Tilda, SOS, La Fallera, Brillante, Saludães, Reis (rice), Panzani, Garofalo, Roland, Ronzoni, American Beauty (pasta). Spain-headquartered, listed on Madrid stock exchange. ~73% of revenue from rice, ~25% from pasta, ~2% from other (sauces, ready meals). FY runs calendar year. Capital allocation: occasional special dividends (FY21 special on sale of Panzani fresh pasta to CVC; FY22 sale of Riviana frozen). Two-step ordinary dividend each year (Apr / Oct). Annual reports / consolidated accounts at ebrofoods.es/en/investor-relations.

periods.notes: FY20: revenue €3.11B (+5%). COVID pantry-loading lifted rice + pasta volumes. Adj EBITDA €360M. Net debt €545M.
FY21: revenue €2.75B. Sold Panzani fresh-pasta to CVC for €550M, recorded €169M gain. Special dividend €0.61 + ordinary €0.57. Net debt down to €410M.
FY22: revenue €2.95B (+7% raw-material pass-through). Wheat / rice price spikes squeezed margin temporarily. Adj EBITDA €295M. Acquired Tilda from Hain (US$340M).
FY23: revenue €3.10B (+5%). Tilda full year. Adj EBITDA recovered to €360M. India rice export ban tightened market. Net debt €705M.
FY24: revenue €3.14B. Adj EBITDA €380M (+5%). EPS ~€1.05. Net debt €720M (~1.9x EBITDA). Strong cash generation. Pasta margin recovery (durum wheat prices normalizing).
